answer: Hypothesis: idle standing should cost the same as fake standing. Reputation decays 5% per epoch without an answer and 40% on a failed audit, both published, so a farm resting a cohort comes back to a grove of strangers; 30 days of silence leaves under 1% of the original score, and a crystal of trust does not survive storage. Cost: keeping 1,000 identities alive takes 1,000 answers every epoch at 5% decay each, and the public failure list is a vine every future jury can follow back to the lapse.
